# Raimov Clinical Case Club

> **SUPERSEDED PRODUCT NAME/DIRECTION by `DEC-864`.** Current professional community authority is `docs/raimov/professional/whole-person-study-club/README.md`. This file is retained for history only.

**Status:** `SUPERSEDED / NOT_LAUNCHED`
**Historical authority:** `docs/ssot/RAIMOV_PERSONAL_BRAND_MODEL.md` + `DEC-863`

The Clinical Case Club is the first professional product: gated case-based learning for doctors centred on clinical reasoning, interdisciplinary planning, sequencing, trade-offs and follow-up.

Before public launch it requires:

- explicit audience and learning outcomes;
- repeatable case-review format and clinical owner;
- sufficient publishable/teachable cases with patient consent, de-identification and rights;
- medical, privacy and legal review;
- approved offer, price, schedule, capacity, terms and professional data flow;
- separate professional analytics and release evidence.

It must not be described as accreditation, certification, a launched Academy or proven methodology before those gates close.
